segments.description: Produces investment periodicals, newsletters, analysis software and financial databases, and licenses Value Line copyrights and proprietary ranks to third parties.
segments.evidence: The investment publications and related publications (retail and institutional) and Value Line copyrights and Value Line Proprietary Ranks and other proprietary information consolidate into one segment called Publishing.

revenueModel.text: The Company earns subscription fees from retail and institutional customers, recognized over the subscription life, plus copyright fees from third parties and non-voting revenues and profits interests from EAM.
revenueModel.evidence: Payments received for new and renewal subscriptions and the value of receivables for amounts billed to retail and institutional customers are recorded as unearned revenue until the order is fulfilled.
